title: SEC2.3: cmd_contacts_list loads all contacts into memory before printing
description:
main.rs lines 93-127 (cmd_contacts_list) loads all contacts into a Vec via store.contacts().list() (line 101), then iterates over the Vec to print (lines 111-123). This loads the entire contacts table into memory before any output is produced.

Impact: Memory usage scales with total number of contacts; large contact lists may be slow to display or use excess RAM.
Fix: Add a streaming variant of ContactStore::list that returns an iterator, or print as each contact is retrieved from the database.
Location: main.rs line 101.
